name: [X2💪] Super Power Training League
desc:
Welcome to Super Power Training League
⚔️ Train to destroy other players or be destroyed by stronger players
⭐ You will also unlock new abilities the stronger your become

x There are 6 Training Stats that determines how strong you are
👊 Power : Makes you deal more Damage
❤️ Health : Be able to endure more pain
🛡️ Defense : Receive less Damage from Enemies
👁️ Psychics : Evolves your abilities
🔮 Magic : Deal more Damage to Magic Abilities
⚡ Mobility : Helps you to travel Faster
